items.syllabus_item: 4.1 Introduction and basics of Digital Theodolite

body.en:
What changed. The digital theodolite keeps Unit 1's geometry — telescope, trunnion axis, two circles — but replaces vernier reading with electronic angle measurement: glass circles carry coded or incremental graduations scanned by light sensors, so horizontal and vertical angles appear on an LCD to 1″–5″ without a magnifier, estimation or vernier blunder. Functions a vernier instrument cannot dream of come free: zero-setting the horizontal circle on any direction, angle hold, left/right angle counting, percent-of-slope display of the vertical angle, and dual-axis compensators that sense residual tilt and correct the vertical angle (and flag an unlevel instrument).

Why it matters. Reading error — Unit 1's commonest personal error — all but disappears; booking shrinks to copying a display (or pressing store). But permanence of errors does not: collimation, axis tilt and index error still live in the instrument, so face-left/face-right discipline, temporary adjustments and closure checks survive unchanged. The digital box changed the reading, not the surveying.
body.gu:
શું બદલાયું: Digital theodolite માં Unit 1 ની જ geometry છે — telescope, trunnion axis, બે circles — પણ vernier ને બદલે electronic angle measurement છે: glass circle પરના coded graduation ને light sensor વાંચે છે, એટલે horizontal અને vertical angle LCD પર 1″–5″ સુધી સીધા દેખાય છે — magnifier, અંદાજ કે vernier ભૂલ વગર. સાથે zero-set, angle hold, slope % display અને dual-axis compensator (બાકી રહેલી tilt sense કરી vertical angle સુધારે છે) જેવી સુવિધાઓ મફત મળે છે.

શા માટે મહત્વનું: reading error — Unit 1 ની સૌથી સામાન્ય personal error — લગભગ ગાયબ થાય છે. પણ collimation, axis tilt અને index error રહે જ છે, એટલે face-left/face-right ની શિસ્ત, temporary adjustment અને closure check બદલાયા નથી. બદલાયું છે ફક્ત reading, surveying નહીં.

body.en:
The idea. EDM measures distance by sending a modulated electromagnetic carrier (infrared light in most total stations) to a reflector prism and back, and timing the journey indirectly by phase comparison (Diagram). The instrument compares the phase of the returned modulation with the transmitted one; the phase difference is a fraction of the modulation wavelength, and distance follows:

D = u x (n + phase fraction) ; u = lambda/2 (unit length) ; lambda = c/f

Resolving the ambiguity. The phase fraction alone repeats every unit length u (10 m at f = 15 MHz), so the integer n of whole units is found by also measuring with coarser modulations (longer wavelengths) whose phase pins down the tens, hundreds… Fine-plus-coarse frequencies are exactly Numerical 4.1's mechanism, reaching ±(2 mm + 2 ppm) class accuracy over hundreds of metres to kilometres, prism permitting. Reflectorless EDM bounces off the surface itself (shorter range, no prism party). EDM killed the tape for control distances just as the analytic lens killed C — Unit 2's optical triangle became a timed photon.
body.gu:
મૂળ વિચાર: EDM modulated electromagnetic carrier (મોટાભાગના total station માં infrared light) ને reflector prism સુધી મોકલી, પરત આવેલા signal ની phase comparison થી distance માપે છે (Diagram). પરત આવેલી modulation ની phase મોકલેલી સાથે સરખાવતાં phase difference મળે છે — તે wavelength નો અંશ હોય છે:

D = u x (n + phase fraction) ; u = lambda/2 ; lambda = c/f

Ambiguity નો ઉકેલ: phase fraction દરેક unit length u (15 MHz પર 10 m) પછી repeat થાય છે, એટલે whole units નો integer n coarse modulation (લાંબી wavelength) થી શોધવામાં આવે છે. Numerical 4.1 માં આ જ ગણતરી છે. Accuracy ±(2 mm + 2 ppm) જેટલી, અંતર સેંકડો metre થી kilometre સુધી. Reflectorless EDM સીધું surface પરથી પાછું આવે છે — prism party ની જરૂર નહીં, પણ range ઓછો હોય છે.

h.en: 4.3 Total station — parts, uses, types and advancement (ATR)
h.gu: 4.3 Total Station — parts, ઉપયોગ, પ્રકારો અને પ્રગતિ (ATR)

items.syllabus_item: 4.3 Introduction and basics of Total Station: parts, advantages/disadvantages, uses, types, advancements, ATR

body.en:
What it is. A total station integrates in one instrument (Diagram): an electronic theodolite (Card 4.1), an EDM (Card 4.2), and a microprocessor with memory — so it measures angles and slope distance, reduces them on the spot to horizontal distance, height difference and coordinates, stores every point with a code, and speaks to computers. Parts: telescope with coaxial EDM, dual LCD/keyboard panels, optical (or laser) plummet, tribrach, compensator, battery, data ports — plus the prism/pole kit at the other end of every sight.

Advantages: speed (seconds per point, coordinates included), accuracy, digital records (no transcription blunders), built-in programs (stake-out, resection, area, remote height). Disadvantages: cost, battery dependence, delicate electronics in dust/rain, and the operator's temptation to trust stored numbers without field checks. Types and advancement: manual → motorised (servo drives) → robotic (tracks the prism, one-person crew) with ATR (Automatic Target Recognition) — the instrument finds, aims at and locks onto the prism itself, measuring on command; imaging stations add cameras/scanning. ATR is the syllabus-named milestone: pointing, the surveyor's oldest manual skill, is the latest thing automated.
body.gu:
શું છે: Total Station એક જ instrument માં ત્રણ વસ્તુ જોડે છે (Diagram): electronic theodolite (Card 4.1), EDM (Card 4.2) અને memory ધરાવતું microprocessor — એટલે તે angle અને slope distance માપી તરત જ horizontal distance, height difference અને coordinates ગણી, દરેક point code સાથે store કરે છે અને computer સાથે વાત કરે છે. Parts: coaxial EDM વાળું telescope, LCD/keyboard, optical plummet, tribrach, compensator, battery, data port — અને બીજા છેડે prism/pole.

ફાયદા: ઝડપ (દરેક point સેકન્ડોમાં, coordinates સાથે), accuracy, digital record (લખવામાં ભૂલ નહીં), built-in programs (stake-out, resection, area). ગેરફાયદા: કિંમત, battery આધાર, નાજુક electronics, અને check કર્યા વગર stored number પર આંધળો વિશ્વાસ મૂકવાની લાલચ. પ્રકારો: manual → motorised → robotic (prism ને જાતે track કરે, એક જ માણસની ટુકડી) ATR (Automatic Target Recognition) સાથે — instrument જાતે prism શોધી, aim કરી, lock કરે છે. Pointing જેવી સૌથી જૂની manual skill જ સૌથી છેલ્લે automate થઈ છે.

h.en: 4.4 Surveying with a total station — parameters and data collection flow
h.gu: 4.4 Total Station થી surveying — parameters અને data collection flow

items.syllabus_item: 4.4 Surveying using Total Station: flow chart of data collection, fundamental parameters

body.en:
Fundamental parameters the instrument works with on every setup: atmospheric correction (temperature/pressure → ppm applied to EDM distances), prism constant (offset of the reflector's optical centre), earth-curvature/refraction settings, angle/distance units, and the compensator mode. Wrong parameters make beautifully precise nonsense — a 30 ppm weather error is 3 cm per kilometre, all of it stored confidently.

The data collection flow (Diagram) is the digital field book: set up and create a JOB → enter the occupied-station setup → orient by backsight → observe and store points (each: point no., code, angles, distance, computed coordinates) → download → process into CAD drawings. Every later card in this unit is one box of this chart expanded: Cards 4.5–4.6 do the setup boxes, Card 4.7 the observe/traverse/download boxes. Nothing in the flow forgives skipping the backsight: orientation is the survey's foundation, and the instrument will happily store a thousand points rotated by your backsight blunder.
body.gu:
Fundamental parameters — દરેક setup પર instrument આ સાથે કામ કરે છે: atmospheric correction (temperature/pressure → EDM distance પર ppm), prism constant, curvature/refraction setting, units અને compensator mode. ખોટા parameter એટલે વિશ્વાસ સાથે store થતી ચોક્કસ ભૂલ — 30 ppm weather error = દરેક kilometre પર 3 cm.

Data collection flow (Diagram) એટલે digital field book: set up કરી JOB બનાવો → occupied station enter કરો → backsight થી orient કરો → point observe અને store કરો (point no., code, angles, distance, coordinates) → download → CAD drawing. આ unit ના બાકીના cards આ જ chart ના બોક્સ છે: Cards 4.5–4.6 setup ના, Card 4.7 observe/traverse/download ના. Backsight છોડશો તો instrument હજાર point ખોટા orientation સાથે હસતાં-હસતાં store કરી દેશે.

h.en: 4.5 Precautions and setting up: centering, levelling, backsight, azimuth
h.gu: 4.5 સાવચેતીઓ અને setup: centering, levelling, backsight, azimuth

items.syllabus_item: 4.5 Precautions while using Total Station; 4.6 Set up: centering, levelling, back-sighting, azimuth marks

body.en:
Setup procedure (the CO4 performance). (1) Tripod firm and roughly level over the station; instrument seated and clamped. (2) Centering: optical/laser plummet onto the ground mark — legs first, then foot screws/shifting head. (3) Levelling: circular bubble roughly by legs, then the electronic plate bubble with foot screws until the compensator is in range (the display tells you; a total station refuses tilted work beyond ~3′). (4) Power on, select/create the job, apply parameters (Card 4.4). (5) Station entry: key the occupied point's coordinates (or 1000,1000,100 assumed) and instrument height. (6) Backsight/orientation: sight the known backsight point (prism centred and plumbed!) and either enter its coordinates — the instrument computes the azimuth — or set the known azimuth mark angle directly. (7) Verify orientation on a second known point before trusting it.

Precautions. Never sight the sun (EDM optics), keep lenses shaded/clean, guard batteries (Card 4.8), don't force compensator warnings, re-check backsight after any tripod knock, and keep prism poles vertical with bipods for control points. The instrument automates arithmetic, never judgment: it will store a mis-centred, wrong-prism-constant, stale-backsight survey with beautiful precision.
body.gu:
Setup procedure (CO4 નું performance): (1) station પર tripod મજબૂત, આશરે level; instrument બેસાડો. (2) Centering: optical/laser plummet ground mark પર — પહેલા legs, પછી foot screw. (3) Levelling: circular bubble legs થી, પછી electronic plate bubble foot screw થી — compensator range માં આવે ત્યાં સુધી. (4) power on, job select/create કરો, parameters (Card 4.4) લગાવો. (5) Station entry: occupied point ના coordinates અને instrument height નાખો. (6) Backsight/orientation: known backsight point (prism vertical!) sight કરી તેના coordinates નાખો — instrument azimuth ગણી લેશે — અથવા known azimuth સીધો set કરો. (7) બીજા known point પર orientation verify કરો.

સાવચેતીઓ: તડકા તરફ ક્યારેય ન તાકો, lens સાફ/છાંયડામાં રાખો, battery સાચવો (Card 4.8), compensator warning ને અવગણો નહીં, tripod ને ધક્કો લાગે તો backsight ફરી check કરો. Instrument ગણતરી automate કરે છે, judgment નહીં.

h.en: 4.6 Measurements, initial settings and creating a job file
h.gu: 4.6 Measurements, initial settings અને job file બનાવવો

items.syllabus_item: 4.7 Various measurements with Total Station; 4.8 Initial setting, creating new file; 4.10 Survey station description, occupied point entries

body.en:
What it measures. In one pointing: horizontal angle, vertical (or zenith) angle, slope distance — reduced live to horizontal distance, height difference and ΔE/ΔN; pointing at successive points yields coordinates directly. Standard programs extend the pointing: remote elevation (height of a point above a prism — towers, wires, Unit 2's trigonometric problem automated), missing-line (distance/gradient between two prisms), offset modes, and area from stored points.

Initial settings and the job file. Before the first point: set units (m, degrees/gon), angle resolution, distance mode (prism/reflectorless, single/repeat/tracking), prism constant, ppm (weather), and two-face averaging if offered. Creating a new file (JOB): name it (site + date), choose the coordinate system/scale factor, then make the occupied point entry: point number, E/N/height (known or assumed), instrument height, and a station description/code so future-you knows what the peg was; backsight entry follows the same pattern (point, height of target, azimuth or coordinates). Settings are part of the survey's provenance: the raw file records them, and viva examiners ask for them in exactly this order.
body.gu:
શું માપે છે: એક pointing માં horizontal angle, vertical/zenith angle, slope distance — તરત જ horizontal distance, height difference અને ΔE/ΔN માં ફેરવાય છે; પછીના points ના coordinates સીધા મળે છે. વધારાના programs: remote elevation (prism ની ઉપરનો point — tower, wire: Unit 2 નો problem જ automate થયો), missing-line (બે prism વચ્ચેનું અંતર/gradient), offsets અને stored points પરથી area.

Initial settings અને job file: પહેલા point પહેલા units, distance mode (prism/reflectorless, single/repeat), prism constant, ppm (weather) set કરો. નવું file (JOB) બનાવવું: નામ આપો (site + date), પછી occupied point entry: point number, E/N/height (known કે assumed), instrument height, અને station નું description/code; backsight entry એ જ pattern માં. Settings એ survey નો ભાગ છે — raw file તેને record કરે છે.

h.en: 4.7 Total station traversing, data retrieval, graphics and construction layout
h.gu: 4.7 Total Station traversing, data retrieval, graphics અને construction layout

items.syllabus_item: 4.9 Total Station traversing; 4.11 Data retrieval; 4.12 Field-generated graphics; 4.13 Construction layout

body.en:
Traversing (CO4). Occupy station 1, backsight a known point, foresight station 2 (prism): the instrument stores angle + distance and computes station 2's coordinates; leapfrog forward, closing on a known point or back at the start. Misclosure is computed by the software exactly as Unit 1's Gale table did by hand — same latitudes/departures in disguise — and adjusted (compass rule in most field software) before the coordinates are final. Total-station traverses run an order faster than theodolite-and-tape and close better, but the ritual is recognisable: centre, level, backsight, both faces on control legs.

Retrieval, graphics, layout. Data retrieval: download by cable/USB/SD/Bluetooth to PC — raw observations plus reduced coordinates, exportable as CSV/DXF; keep the raw file: coordinates can be recomputed, raw angles cannot be re-observed. Field-generated graphics: the controller draws points/lines live — the surveyor sees the plan grow, spots the missed corner in the field. Construction layout (stake-out): upload design coordinates, and the instrument guides the prism by angle-and-distance (or ΔE/ΔN) until design and ground coincide — columns, road centre-lines, curve pegs (Unit 3 closes its loop here) set out at walking speed.
body.gu:
Traversing (CO4): station 1 પર બેસી known point નું backsight, પછી station 2 (prism) નું foresight — instrument angle + distance store કરી station 2 ના coordinates ગણે છે; આગળ વધતા જાઓ, known point પર કે શરૂઆત પર close કરો. Misclosure software Unit 1 ના Gale table ની જેમ જ ગણે છે — એ જ latitude/departure, નવા વેશમાં — અને compass rule થી adjust થાય છે. ઝડપ ઘણી વધારે, પણ શિસ્ત એ જ છે: centre, level, backsight, control leg પર બંને face.

Retrieval, graphics, layout: data retrieval — cable/USB/Bluetooth થી PC માં download, CSV/DXF export; raw file હંમેશા સાચવો: coordinates ફરી ગણી શકાય, raw angle ફરી observe ન થાય. Field graphics — controller live plan દોરે છે, એટલે ચૂકી ગયેલો ખૂણો field માં જ દેખાય છે. Construction layout (stake-out) — design coordinates upload કરો, instrument prism ને angle-distance થી માર્ગદર્શન આપે છે જ્યાં સુધી design અને જમીન એક ન થાય — column, road centre-line, curve peg (Unit 3 અહીં પૂરું થાય છે).

h.en: 4.8 Computerised data, job planning — and the hand-held GPS
h.gu: 4.8 Computerised data, job planning — અને Hand-Held GPS

items.syllabus_item: 4.14 Computerized survey data system; 4.15 Battery, job planning, estimating; 4.16-4.17 Hand-held GPS: introduction, uses, field procedures

body.en:
The office end. A computerised survey data system chains field controllers → transfer → processing software (adjustment, DTM/contours) → CAD/GIS drawings: the deliverable plan is computed, not drafted, and the raw-to-drawing chain stays auditable. Job planning and estimating is the unglamorous multiplier: reconnoitre control, fix the point-coding scheme, estimate points/day and crew, plan traverses to close, and maintain battery power — charged spares, rotation, no instrument left in a hot vehicle; a dead total station at 4 pm writes off the day's last traverse leg and tomorrow's re-occupation cost.

Hand-held GPS (Diagram). A receiver that listens to navigation satellites: each satellite broadcasts its position and a precise time tick; the receiver measures signal travel times → ranges → intersecting spheres fix latitude, longitude and height (a 4th satellite resolves the receiver's cheap clock). Uses: reconnaissance, asset/GIS mapping, approximate control (metre-level; centimetres need survey-grade RTK), navigation, geotagging photos/records. Field procedure: plan for open sky (satellite geometry/PDOP), power on and let it fix and average several minutes at the point, record waypoints with names, mark accuracy shown, keep the antenna clear of body/metal, download tracks/waypoints the same evening. It is the survey's sketch tool — fast, everywhere, and honestly approximate; CO4 asks you to demonstrate it, not to boundary-survey with it.
body.gu:
Office તરફનો છેડો: computerised survey data system field controller → transfer → processing software (adjustment, DTM/contour) → CAD/GIS drawing ને જોડે છે: plan દોરવામાં નથી આવતો, ગણવામાં આવે છે, અને raw થી drawing સુધીની શૃંખલા તપાસી શકાય છે. Job planning અને estimating: control ની ઓળખ, point-coding scheme, દરરોજના points અને crew નો અંદાજ, close થાય એવા traverse plan — અને battery power ની જાળવણી: charged spare, rotation, ગરમ વાહનમાં instrument ન છોડવું; સાંજે 4 વાગ્યે બંધ પડેલું station આખો દિવસ બગાડે છે.

Hand-Held GPS (Diagram): navigation satellite ના signal સાંભળતું receiver: દરેક satellite પોતાનું સ્થાન અને ચોક્કસ time tick મોકલે છે; receiver travel time માપી range કાઢે છે → ગોળાઓ છેદાતાં latitude, longitude, height મળે છે (ચોથો satellite receiver ની સસ્તી clock સુધારે છે). ઉપયોગ: reconnaissance, asset/GIS mapping, આશરે control (metre-level; cm માટે survey-grade RTK જોઈએ), navigation, geotagging. Field procedure: ખુલ્લું આકાશ પસંદ કરો (PDOP), fix થવા દઈ થોડી મિનિટ average કરો, waypoint નામ સાથે record કરો, દર્શાવેલી accuracy નોંધો, તે જ સાંજે download કરો. તે survey નું sketch tool છે — ઝડપી, બધે ચાલે, અને પ્રામાણિકપણે આશરે ચોક્કસ; CO4 માં demonstrate કરવાનું છે.

title.en: Numerical 4.1 — Distance from EDM phase measurement
title.gu: Numerical 4.1 — EDM phase measurement થી distance

body.en:
Given. An EDM modulates its carrier at f = 15 MHz (speed of light c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s). Coarse frequencies report 25 complete unit lengths; the fine phase measurement gives a fraction 0.368 of a unit. Find the distance.

Step 1. Modulation wavelength and unit length.

lambda = c/f = 3 x 10^8 / 15 x 10^6 = 20 m ; unit length u = lambda/2 = 10 m

Step 2. Assemble whole units plus the phase fraction.

D = u x (n + fraction) = 10 x (25 + 0.368) = 10 x 25.368 = 253.68 m

Final answer.

╔ Distance = 253.68 m - counted in whole 10 m units, finished by a phase fraction ╗

Validity check. The phase fraction can only ever give the part inside one 10 m unit — without the coarse-frequency count of n = 25, the same phase reading fits 3.68 m, 13.68 m, 23.68 m… (Card 4.2). That ambiguity resolution is the invisible half of every EDM specification.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: EDM carrier ને f = 15 MHz પર modulate કરે છે (c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s). Coarse frequencies 25 પૂરા unit length કહે છે; fine phase measurement fraction 0.368 આપે છે. Distance શોધો.

Step 1. Modulation wavelength અને unit length.

lambda = 3 x 10^8 / 15 x 10^6 = 20 m ; u = lambda/2 = 10 m

Step 2. પૂરા units + phase fraction જોડો.

D = 10 x (25 + 0.368) = 253.68 m

અંતિમ જવાબ:

╔ Distance = 253.68 m — 10 m ના પૂરા units ગણ્યા, છેલ્લો ભાગ phase fraction થી ╗

ચકાસણી: phase fraction ફક્ત એક 10 m unit ની અંદરનો ભાગ જ આપે છે — n = 25 ના coarse count વગર એ જ reading 3.68 m, 13.68 m, 23.68 m… બધે બેસે (Card 4.2).

title.en: Numerical 4.2 — Coordinates of a point from a total station observation
title.gu: Numerical 4.2 — Total Station observation થી point ના coordinates

body.en:
Given. Total station on occupied point A (E 1000.000, N 1000.000). Backsight azimuth 45°00′. To point P: horizontal angle (clockwise from backsight) 120°30′, slope distance 85.40 m, zenith angle 88°15′. Compute P's coordinates.

Step 1. Azimuth of AP.

azimuth AP = 45 deg 00 min + 120 deg 30 min = 165 deg 30 min

Step 2. Reduce slope distance to horizontal (zenith angle from vertical).

H = S sin(z) = 85.40 x sin(88 deg 15 min) = 85.40 x 0.99953 = 85.36 m

Step 3. Coordinate differences (ΔE = H sin az, ΔN = H cos az).

delta E = 85.36 x sin(165.5 deg) = 85.36 x 0.2504 = +21.37 m ; delta N = 85.36 x cos(165.5 deg) = 85.36 x (-0.9682) = -82.64 m

Final answer.

╔ P = (E 1021.37 , N 917.36) - one pointing: angle + slope distance became map coordinates ╗

Validity check. Signs come from the azimuth's quadrant (165°30′ is SE: E increases, N decreases — matches). Inside the instrument this exact arithmetic happens per point, hundreds of times a day (Cards 4.3, 4.6); doing it once by hand is how you learn what to audit.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Total Station occupied point A (E 1000.000, N 1000.000) પર. Backsight azimuth 45°00′. Point P તરફ: horizontal angle (backsight થી clockwise) 120°30′, slope distance 85.40 m, zenith angle 88°15′. P ના coordinates ગણો.

Step 1. AP નો azimuth.

azimuth AP = 45 deg + 120 deg 30 min = 165 deg 30 min

Step 2. Slope distance ને horizontal માં ફેરવો.

H = 85.40 x sin(88 deg 15 min) = 85.36 m

Step 3. Coordinate તફાવત (ΔE = H sin az, ΔN = H cos az).

delta E = +21.37 m ; delta N = -82.64 m

અંતિમ જવાબ:

╔ P = (E 1021.37 , N 917.36) — એક pointing: angle + slope distance coordinates બની ગયા ╗

ચકાસણી: sign azimuth ના quadrant થી આવે છે (165°30′ એ SE છે: E વધે, N ઘટે — મળે છે). Instrument અંદર આ જ ગણતરી દરેક point પર, દિવસમાં સેંકડો વખત થાય છે (Cards 4.3, 4.6).

title.en: Numerical 4.3 — RL of a point from zenith angle and slope distance
title.gu: Numerical 4.3 — Zenith angle અને slope distance થી point નો RL

body.en:
Given. Station RL 200.00 m, instrument height 1.52 m. To a prism (pole height 1.30 m): slope distance 60.25 m, zenith angle 92°30′ (i.e. the sight dips below horizontal). Find the horizontal distance and the RL of the prism point.

Step 1. Height of instrument axis.

HI = 200.00 + 1.52 = 201.52 m

Step 2. Vertical component — zenith past 90° means downward, and cos turns negative by itself.

V = S cos(z) = 60.25 x cos(92 deg 30 min) = 60.25 x (-0.04362) = -2.63 m

Step 3. Horizontal distance and RL (climb V, then down the prism pole).

H = S sin(z) = 60.25 x sin(92 deg 30 min) = 60.19 m ; RL = HI + V - prism height = 201.52 - 2.63 - 1.30 = 197.59 m

Final answer.

╔ Horizontal distance 60.19 m ; RL of point = 197.59 m - Unit 2's V-bookkeeping, now automatic ╗

Validity check. This is Numerical 2.3 wearing a zenith angle: V = S cos z is the same vertical component as (Ks/2) sin 2θ once θ = 90° − z. Forget to enter the prism height and every RL is wrong by exactly that pole length — the classic total-station blunder, hence its place in Card 4.6's entry ritual.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Station RL 200.00 m, instrument height 1.52 m. Prism (pole height 1.30 m) તરફ: slope distance 60.25 m, zenith angle 92°30′ (sight horizontal થી નીચે છે). Horizontal distance અને prism point નો RL શોધો.

Step 1. Instrument axis ની height.

HI = 200.00 + 1.52 = 201.52 m

Step 2. Vertical component — zenith 90° થી વધુ એટલે નીચે તરફ; cos જાતે negative થાય છે.

V = 60.25 x cos(92 deg 30 min) = -2.63 m

Step 3. Horizontal distance અને RL.

H = 60.19 m ; RL = 201.52 - 2.63 - 1.30 = 197.59 m

અંતિમ જવાબ:

╔ Horizontal distance 60.19 m ; RL = 197.59 m — Unit 2 નું V જ, હવે automatic ╗

ચકાસણી: prism height નાખવાનું ભૂલશો તો દરેક RL બરાબર એ pole જેટલો ખોટો આવશે — total station ની સૌથી જાણીતી ભૂલ, એટલે Card 4.6 માં તે entry ritual નો ભાગ છે.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 4
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 4

body.en:
EDM: lambda = c/f ; unit u = lambda/2 ; D = u(n + phase fraction) - coarse counts n, phase finishes (N4.1)azimuth of line = backsight azimuth + horizontal angle (clockwise) ; H = S sin(zenith) ; V = S cos(zenith)delta E = H sin(azimuth) ; delta N = H cos(azimuth) ; point = occupied + (delta E, delta N) (N4.2)RL of point = (station RL + instrument height) + V - prism/target height (N4.3)

Four lines run every total-station day: orientation gives azimuth, zenith splits slope into H and V, azimuth splits H into ΔE/ΔN, heights ride on V.
body.gu:
EDM: lambda = c/f ; u = lambda/2 ; D = u(n + phase fraction) (Numerical 4.1)line નો azimuth = backsight azimuth + horizontal angle ; H = S sin(zenith) ; V = S cos(zenith)delta E = H sin(azimuth) ; delta N = H cos(azimuth) ; point = occupied + (delta E, delta N) (Numerical 4.2)point નો RL = (station RL + instrument height) + V - prism height (Numerical 4.3)

દરેક total-station દિવસ આ ચાર line પર ચાલે છે: orientation azimuth આપે, zenith slope ને H અને V માં, azimuth H ને ΔE/ΔN માં વહેંચે, height V પર સવારી કરે.

name.en: Setup ritual and key data — field checklist
name.gu: Setup ritual અને key data — field checklist

body.en:
order: tripod firm -> centre (plummet) -> level (electronic bubble, compensator in range) -> job + parameters (ppm, prism constant, units) -> occupied point entry (+ instrument height) -> backsight entry/orient -> verify on second known pointtypical accuracies: angles 1-5 sec ; EDM distance +/-(2 mm + 2 ppm) ; reflectorless shorter range ; hand-held GPS metre-level, survey RTK centimetre-levelstore raw data, download daily, two copies ; stake-out = reverse arithmetic: design coordinates -> angle + distance to guide the prismbattery planning: charged spares rotated, instrument never left in hot vehicles - the 4 pm failure writes off the day

The instrument stores precision; only the ritual stores correctness — viva answers that list checks beat answers that list features.
body.gu:
ક્રમ: tripod મજબૂત -> centre (plummet) -> level (electronic bubble) -> job + parameters (ppm, prism constant, units) -> occupied point entry (+ instrument height) -> backsight/orient -> બીજા known point પર verifyલાક્ષણિક accuracy: angle 1-5 sec ; EDM +/-(2 mm + 2 ppm) ; hand-held GPS metre-level, RTK centimetre-levelraw data store કરો, દરરોજ download, બે copies ; stake-out = ઊલટી ગણતરી: design coordinates -> prism ને guide કરતા angle + distancebattery planning: charged spare ફેરવતા રહો, instrument ગરમ વાહનમાં ન છોડો

Instrument precision store કરે છે; ritual જ correctness store કરે છે.

q.en: Total station — define it by its three ancestors.
q.gu: Total Station — તેના ત્રણ પૂર્વજોથી વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

a.en: An electronic theodolite (angles), an EDM (distance by phase-compared modulated light), and a computer with memory (reduces, coordinates, stores) in one box. Remove any leg and you are back to a Unit 1 or Unit 2 instrument (Card 4.3).
a.gu: Electronic theodolite (angle), EDM (phase-compare કરેલા modulated light થી distance) અને memory ધરાવતું computer (ગણતરી, coordinates, store) — એક જ box માં. એક પણ કાઢી નાખો તો તમે Unit 1 કે Unit 2 ના instrument પર પાછા આવી જાઓ (Card 4.3).

q.en: Why phase comparison instead of timing the light pulse directly?
q.gu: Light pulse ને સીધો time કરવાને બદલે phase comparison કેમ?

a.en: Light covers 300 m in a microsecond; direct timing to millimetres needs picosecond electronics. Phase comparison converts the same information into a fraction of a wavelength measurable by ordinary electronics — precision without a stopwatch (Numerical 4.1).
a.gu: પ્રકાશ 300 m એક microsecond માં કાપે છે; millimetre સુધી સીધું timing picosecond electronics માંગે. Phase comparison એ જ માહિતીને wavelength ના અંશમાં ફેરવી સામાન્ય electronics થી માપી શકાય એવું બનાવે છે — stopwatch વગર precision (Numerical 4.1).

q.en: The phase fraction repeats every 10 m. How does the instrument know it's 253 m, not 43 m?
q.gu: Phase fraction દરેક 10 m એ repeat થાય છે. Instrument ને કેવી રીતે ખબર કે 43 m નહીં 253 m છે?

a.en: Multiple modulation frequencies: coarse (long-wavelength) measurements count the whole 10 m units (n = 25), the fine frequency measures the 0.368 fraction inside the current unit. Coarse counts, fine finishes (Card 4.2).
a.gu: ઘણી modulation frequencies: coarse (લાંબી wavelength) માપણી પૂરા 10 m units ગણે છે (n = 25), fine frequency ચાલુ unit ની અંદરનો 0.368 fraction માપે છે. Coarse ગણે, fine પૂરું કરે (Card 4.2).

q.en: What does ATR actually do, and what job disappears?
q.gu: ATR ખરેખર શું કરે છે, અને કોનું કામ ગાયબ થાય છે?

a.en: Automatic Target Recognition: the instrument's sensor finds the prism, drives the telescope onto it, locks and follows it. The instrument-man's continuous aiming job disappears — robotic stations need only a prism carrier, and he can be the one walking (Card 4.3).
a.gu: Automatic Target Recognition: instrument નું sensor prism શોધે છે, telescope તેના પર લઈ જાય છે, lock અને follow કરે છે. Instrument-man નું સતત aim કરવાનું કામ ગાયબ થાય છે — robotic station ને ફક્ત prism વહન કરનાર જોઈએ છે (Card 4.3).

q.en: Your total station shows coordinates instantly. Why still observe face left and face right on traverse legs?
q.gu: Coordinates તરત દેખાય છે, છતાં traverse leg પર face left/face right કેમ?

a.en: Because collimation and index errors live in the instrument regardless of electronics (Card 4.1); the two-face mean cancels them exactly as with a vernier instrument. The display being digital does not repeal geometry.
a.gu: કારણ કે collimation અને index error electronics હોય કે ન હોય, instrument માં રહે જ છે (Card 4.1); બે face નું mean તેમને vernier instrument ની જેમ જ cancel કરે છે. Display digital હોવાથી geometry નો નિયમ રદ નથી થતો.

q.en: You forgot to change the prism constant after swapping prisms. Signature in the data?
q.gu: Prism બદલ્યા પછી prism constant બદલવાનો ભૂલી ગયા. Data માં નિશાની?

a.en: Every distance wrong by the constant difference (typically 30 mm) — coordinates shift radially from each instrument station, and a closed traverse shows a scale-like misclosure. Constant belongs in the setup checklist, not in memory (Card 4.4).
a.gu: દરેક distance constant ના તફાવત (સામાન્ય રીતે 30 mm) જેટલો ખોટો — coordinates દરેક station થી radially ખસે, closed traverse માં scale જેવો misclosure દેખાય. Constant checklist માં હોવું જોઈએ, યાદશક્તિમાં નહીં (Card 4.4).

q.en: Zenith angle 92°30′ — what is V's sign and who decided it?
q.gu: Zenith angle 92°30′ — V નો sign શું અને કોણે નક્કી કર્યો?

a.en: Negative: V = S cos z and cos(92°30′) < 0 because the sight drops below horizontal. The zenith convention decides signs automatically — one reason instruments prefer zenith over elevation angles (Numerical 4.3).
a.gu: Negative: V = S cos z અને cos(92°30′) < 0 કારણ કે sight horizontal થી નીચે છે. Zenith ની પદ્ધતિ sign જાતે નક્કી કરે છે — એટલે જ instruments elevation કરતાં zenith પસંદ કરે છે (Numerical 4.3).

q.en: Why enter an assumed station (1000, 1000, 100) on a site with no control?
q.gu: Control વગરની site પર assumed station (1000, 1000, 100) કેમ નાખો છો?

a.en: To keep all coordinates positive and comfortably large (avoids negative E/N blunders and lost signs in booking) while the site grid is arbitrary but internally consistent; it is tied to real control later by a transformation if needed (Card 4.6).
a.gu: બધા coordinates positive અને પૂરતા મોટા રાખવા — negative E/N ની ભૂલ અને sign ખોવાય એ ટાળવા; site grid મનસ્વી પણ અંદરથી સુસંગત રહે છે, જરૂર પડે તો પછીથી ખરા control સાથે transformation થી જોડાય છે (Card 4.6).

q.en: Stake-out: the instrument shows 'left 0.42, forward 0.18'. Explain to the prism-man.
q.gu: Stake-out માં instrument 'left 0.42, forward 0.18' બતાવે છે. Prism-man ને સમજાવો.

a.en: The instrument is solving the reverse problem: from design coordinates it computed where the prism should be versus where it is, and speaks in moves — shift the pole 0.42 m left and 0.18 m forward (from the instrument's viewpoint) until both read zero (Card 4.7).
a.gu: Instrument ઊલટો problem ઉકેલે છે: design coordinates પરથી prism ક્યાં હોવો જોઈએ અને ક્યાં છે તે સરખાવી હલનચલનમાં બોલે છે — pole 0.42 m ડાબે, 0.18 m આગળ ખસેડો જ્યાં સુધી બંને zero થાય (Card 4.7).

q.en: Raw data versus coordinates — which do you archive and why?
q.gu: Raw data કે coordinates — કયું archive કરશો અને કેમ?

a.en: Raw. Coordinates can always be recomputed from raw angles/distances with corrected parameters; raw observations can never be re-created from coordinates. The raw file is the survey's evidence; coordinates are merely its current opinion (Card 4.7).
a.gu: Raw. Raw angles/distances પરથી સુધારેલા parameters સાથે coordinates હંમેશા ફરી ગણી શકાય; coordinates પરથી raw observation ફરી બની શકતું નથી. Raw file એ survey નો પુરાવો છે, coordinates તેનો હાલનો અભિપ્રાય (Card 4.7).

q.en: Hand-held GPS gives your position to 3 m. Why can't it set a boundary corner?
q.gu: Hand-held GPS 3 m માં position આપે છે. Boundary corner કેમ ન મૂકી શકે?

a.en: Boundary work demands centimetre-defensible positions tied to control; a code-phase handset's metres of error (atmosphere, satellite geometry, cheap clock — only partly fixed by the 4th satellite) exceed a plot's tolerance. Right tool for reconnaissance/GIS, wrong tool for title (Card 4.8).
a.gu: Boundary work ને control સાથે જોડાયેલી centimetre-ચોકસાઈ જોઈએ છે; code-phase handset ની metres ની error (વાતાવરણ, satellite geometry, સસ્તી clock) plot ની tolerance કરતાં વધી જાય છે. Reconnaissance/GIS માટે સાચું tool, માલિકી હક માટે ખોટું (Card 4.8).

q.en: Two batteries, one charger, three-day traverse camp. Your power plan?
q.gu: બે battery, એક charger, ત્રણ દિવસનું traverse camp. તમારો power plan?

a.en: Rotate: one battery in the instrument, one fully charged spare carried, charger running each night on the day-used pair so no morning starts below full; instrument and batteries never stored in a hot vehicle; observations planned so traverse legs close before the light — and before the battery — dies (Card 4.8).
a.gu: Rotation: એક battery instrument માં, એક fully charged spare સાથે, દરરોજ રાત્રે વપરાયેલી જોડી charge કરો જેથી કોઈ સવાર અડધીથી શરૂ ન થાય; instrument/battery ગરમ વાહનમાં ક્યારેય ન રાખો; traverse legs પ્રકાશ — અને battery — પૂરો થાય એ પહેલા close થાય એમ plan કરો (Card 4.8).

q.en: Explain the principle of EDM by phase comparison with a diagram. How is the integer ambiguity resolved using multiple modulation frequencies?
q.gu: Diagram સાથે phase comparison થી EDM નો principle સમજાવો. Multiple modulation frequency વાપરીને integer ambiguity કેવી રીતે ઉકેલાય છે?

q.en: With a neat sketch, describe the parts of a total station and explain ATR. State the advantages and disadvantages of a total station over a vernier theodolite with tape.
q.gu: Neat sketch સાથે Total Station ના parts વર્ણવી ATR સમજાવો. Vernier theodolite + tape ની સરખામણીએ Total Station ના ફાયદા અને ગેરફાયદા જણાવો.

q.en: Describe step-by-step the setup of a total station on a station: centering, levelling, creating a job, occupied point entry and backsight orientation. What precautions are taken?
q.gu: Total Station ને station પર set-up કરવાની step-by-step રીત વર્ણવો: centering, levelling, job બનાવવો, occupied point entry અને backsight orientation. કઈ સાવચેતીઓ લેવાય છે?

q.en: Give the flowchart of total station data collection and explain data retrieval, field-generated graphics and construction layout (stake-out).
q.gu: Total Station data collection નો flowchart આપો અને data retrieval, field-generated graphics અને construction layout (stake-out) સમજાવો.

q.en: How is a traverse conducted with a total station (CO4)? How is its misclosure computed and adjusted, and how does this compare with the Gale's table method of Unit 1?
q.gu: Total Station થી traverse કેવી રીતે conducted થાય છે (CO4)? તેનો misclosure કેવી રીતે ગણાય અને adjust થાય છે, અને Unit 1 ની Gale's table method સાથે તેની સરખામણી કરો.

q.en: Explain the working of a hand-held GPS: how ranges from satellites fix a 3D position (why four satellites?), its uses, accuracy limits and the field procedure of demonstration.
q.gu: Hand-Held GPS નું કાર્ય સમજાવો: satellite ના ranges 3D position કેવી રીતે નક્કી કરે છે (ચાર satellite કેમ?), તેના ઉપયોગ, accuracy મર્યાદા અને demonstration ની field procedure.

q.en: (a) An EDM (f = 15 MHz) counts 25 whole units with phase fraction 0.368 — find the distance. (b) From station A (E 1000, N 1000), backsight azimuth 45 degrees, point P is observed at horizontal angle 120 deg 30 min, slope distance 85.40 m, zenith 88 deg 15 min — compute P's coordinates and (c) with station RL 200.00 m, instrument height 1.52 m, slope 60.25 m at zenith 92 deg 30 min to a 1.30 m prism, find the point's RL.
q.gu: (a) EDM (f = 15 MHz) 25 પૂરા units અને phase fraction 0.368 ગણે છે — distance શોધો. (b) Station A (E 1000, N 1000) થી backsight azimuth 45 degree, point P: horizontal angle 120 deg 30 min, slope distance 85.40 m, zenith 88 deg 15 min — P ના coordinates ગણો અને (c) station RL 200.00 m, instrument height 1.52 m, 1.30 m prism તરફ slope 60.25 m zenith 92 deg 30 min હોય તો point નો RL શોધો.

q.en: Describe the fundamental parameters set before total station work (atmospheric ppm, prism constant, units, compensator) and explain the consequence of an error in each.
q.gu: Total Station કાર્ય પહેલા set થતા fundamental parameters વર્ણવો (atmospheric ppm, prism constant, units, compensator) અને દરેકમાં ભૂલનું પરિણામ સમજાવો.
